pages.title: The Salvage Anvil
pages.text: At the Identifier, choose $(bold)Salvage$(). Place or shift-click up to seven identified items onto the anvil.$(br2)The anvil shows your credit return and XP fee. Unidentified items and gear with no salvage value are rejected. Remove anything you want to keep.

pages.title: Review, Then Strike
pages.text: Click $(bold)Review$(), check the gear, XP fee and credit return, then click $(bold)Salvage$(). This destroys the gear and pays the fee.$(br2)Changing inputs cancels review. Closing or returning to Identify gives back unconsumed gear. Reviewing is free.
